research_findings: Identified that the `joinWaitlist` action in `src/app/actions/waitlist.ts` had a TODO for rate limiting before heavy traffic.
Found that the project uses `@upstash/redis` in some other contexts (LangChain), so adding `@upstash/ratelimit` and `@upstash/redis` is well aligned.
features_improved: Implemented rate limiting on the waitlist signup action (`joinWaitlist`) using Upstash Redis to prevent abuse during heavy traffic.
new_features_added: Added a reusable `ratelimit` utility in `src/lib/ratelimit.ts` that gracefully degrades (allows requests) if environment variables are missing.
next_steps_for_next_run: Apply the `ratelimit` utility to other server actions, such as user progress updates or AI evaluation endpoints, that may be susceptible to abuse.
